engine.expert_streaming.title: Next-layer expert fill
engine.expert_streaming.detail: Iterates all experts in the next layer, skips cache hits and plans missing gate/up/down ranges for overlapping reads and copies. This is next-layer prefetch rather than per-token expert prediction.

engine.expert_streaming.title: ds4_gpu_stream_expert_cache_prefetch_finish
engine.expert_streaming.detail: Finishes or cancels the outstanding asynchronous fill before slot and transfer state can be reused.

engine.expert_streaming.title: EagerExecutor._run
engine.expert_streaming.detail: Counts actual top-k IDs, derives distinct required experts and plans waves against bounded resident slots and host rows. The resulting partial waves are combined before returning hidden rows. This paged-experts subsystem requires a model-specific integration check.

placement.partition_model.title: LRUPolicy.place
placement.partition_model.detail: Maps a requested wave to fast-tier slots, preserves resident hits and returns the misses to load. This is a runtime expert-placement policy with a fixed slot count.

placement.partition_model.title: ds4_compute_layer_placement
placement.partition_model.detail: Accepts layer entry sizes and placement constraints and computes a layer assignment. Use a capacity-feasible assignment before submitting layer work.

placement.partition_model.title: ds4_ssd_auto_cache_plan
placement.partition_model.detail: Accounts for the model limit, recommended memory, non-routed bytes and bytes per expert when sizing the expert cache. Fixed model data and routed weight slots compete for the same budget.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: get_model_loader
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Selects a loader from the configured model and load format; checkpoint compatibility is an explicit startup decision.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: safetensors_weights_iterator
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Iterates named weight tensors from safetensors shards so a model-specific binder can assign the incoming tensors.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: ds4_engine_open_internal
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Opens a concrete engine with its model artifacts and options. This is a native startup integration boundary rather than proof the implementation accepts Muse models.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: ds4_repack_build_q2k_aligned
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: Builds the aligned Q2_K layout for ds4 matrix multiplication. Retaining scale and lane order is required when targeting a different kernel.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: write_experts
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: Packs per-tensor expert rows into the expert-cache object layout and writes them for later direct IO. This covers storage layout preparation; the routine does not itself change quantization precision.

weights.decode_blocks.title: dequant_q8_0_to_f16_kernel
weights.decode_blocks.detail: Decodes Q8_0 packed weights to a half-precision output buffer. The accepted block format and output dtype are explicit compatibility boundaries.

weights.decode_blocks.title: dequantize_block_q6_K
weights.decode_blocks.detail: CUDA kernel extracts the Q6_K bit fields and applies quantization scales before storing a decoded tile; compare with a Q6_K reference oracle.

memory.runtime_arenas.title: cuda_tmp_alloc_on
memory.runtime_arenas.detail: Associates temporary allocations with a logical memory tier, checks capacity/identity on special paths and selects the corresponding device allocator.

memory.runtime_arenas.title: FinalizePushWorkspace
memory.runtime_arenas.detail: Binds rank, device, hidden width and a symmetric workspace lease to the fused Muse finalize path. Push slots require dependency-ordered launches; this concrete example concerns a tensor-parallel backend.

observability.runtime_events.title: SchedulerReqTimeStats
observability.runtime_events.detail: Tracks request phases with scheduler-owned timing state so work can be attributed to the request timeline.

observability.runtime_events.title: metal_graph_profile_router_selection
observability.runtime_events.detail: Captures actual selected expert IDs in the Metal graph path for routing analysis. A selection trace measures demand; it does not establish prediction quality.

observability.runtime_events.title: Gate optional host ranges for scheduler stages
observability.runtime_events.detail: The stage wrapper supplies a scheduler-specific range name and the NVTX enable flag. It shows optional source annotations around work; GPU completion needs a device-side timeline.

observability.runtime_events.title: Enter an NVTX annotation scope only when enabled
observability.runtime_events.detail: The context manager can enter an NVTX annotation and independently support profiler recording. This is an implementation example for the marker CC.

backend.execute_operators.title: register_attention_backend
backend.execute_operators.detail: Registers named attention implementations. Model geometry and hardware qualification still govern which registered implementation can execute.

backend.execute_operators.title: ds4_mmq_dense_impl
backend.execute_operators.detail: Dispatches dense quantized matrix work through a CUDA implementation, giving the worker a concrete shape/layout-dependent numerical path.

scheduler.request_lifecycle.title: dequeue
scheduler.request_lifecycle.detail: Waits for queued work or shutdown under the request mutex, removes the next job, and hands ownership to the serving worker. This evidence covers queue lifecycle only.

scheduler.request_lifecycle.title: process_batch_result
scheduler.request_lifecycle.detail: Consumes completed model work and dispatches result handling by batch kind, linking iteration results back to scheduler-owned request state.

batch.execution_layout.title: get_new_batch_prefill
batch.execution_layout.detail: Forms the next prefill plan in the context of the currently running batch, making prompt admission and iteration capacity a shared decision.

decode.advance_sequence.title: ds4_session_sync
decode.advance_sequence.detail: Synchronizes a session to a supplied prompt token sequence before continuation.

decode.advance_sequence.title: ds4_session_eval
decode.advance_sequence.detail: Runs evaluation of one supplied token against a session; caller-owned sampling and output remain separate completion steps.

graph.lower_capture_replay.title: ds4_gpu_decode_graph_begin
graph.lower_capture_replay.detail: Starts graph handling with an explicit decode graph key. Replay eligibility depends on the shape and resources represented by that key.

graph.lower_capture_replay.title: DecodeCudaGraphRunner
graph.lower_capture_replay.detail: Manages captured decode execution as a distinct fast path in the model runner.

model.expert_ffn.title: EagerExecutor._run_waves
model.expert_ffn.detail: Runs expert computation in bounded waves and merges their partial results. The wave scheduler preserves assignments even when distinct experts exceed resident slots.

merge.expert_contributions.title: Return combined paged-expert outputs
merge.expert_contributions.detail: Calls the runner contract to finish the merged wave results with the input hidden rows and routed scaling factor before returning standard combine input.

model.logit_head.title: Project the normalized row into vocabulary logits
model.logit_head.detail: The Q8_0 output matrix consumes the normalized hidden row and writes logits. This establishes the vocabulary projection job in this model family.

model.logit_head.title: Pass Muse hidden states and its LM head to logits processing
model.logit_head.detail: The Muse forward path supplies input IDs, hidden states, the model’s LM head and the current forward batch to the logits processor.

model.embedding_service.title: Look up Muse token embeddings
model.embedding_service.detail: When precomputed input embeddings are absent, the Muse implementation gathers embedding rows using the input token IDs.
